# Vendored Borba Design System

Snapshot of the files CLDocs needs from the Borba Design System, so the site
builds in CI and on any machine. The source of truth is
`~/Documents/borba-design-system/`; refresh with `scripts/sync-design-system.sh`.

| File | Use |
|---|---|
| `tipografia.md` | Rules the stylesheet follows (reference only) |
| `tokens.css` | Colour, radius and font tokens, copied verbatim into the site |
| `fonts/Inter.ttf`, `fonts/JetBrainsMono.ttf` | Body and monospace fonts, SIL Open Font License 1.1 (Google Fonts) |

Do not edit these files here; change the source and sync.
